'''Ur-greedles''' were large [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoids]] that were native to the plains of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. Although they were shorter, they were evolutionary relatives of the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]], but unlike their genetic cousins, they were only [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]]. The ur-greedles were attracted to shiny objects, and made off with a few [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]].<ref name="GORW" />

The species had a hard, [[Color/Legends|crimson]]-colored [[exoskeleton]], three digits with talon-like claws that could be used for digging, and six wings that gave ur-greedles the capability to fly. A subterranean herd animal, ur-greedles inhabited dirt mounds that resembled the [[Geonosian hive/Legends|hives]] of the Geonosians—at least from the outside.<ref name="GORW" />
